content: वि {%ind.%} .²1 As a prefix to verbs and nouns it expresses: .³({%a%}) separation, disjunction (apart, asunder, away, off <ab>&c.</ab>), as वियुज्, विहृ, विचल् <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) the reverse of an action; as क्री ‘to buy’; विक्री, ‘to sell’; स्मृ ‘to remember’; विस्मृ ‘to forget’; .³({%c%}) division; as विभज्, विभाग; .³({%d%}) distinction; as विशिष्, विशेष, विविच्, विवेक; .³({%e%}) discrimination; व्यवच्छेद; .³({%f%}) order, arrangement; as विधा, विरच्; .³({%g%}) opposition; as विरुध्, विरोध; .³({%h%}) privation; as विनी, विनयन; .³({%i%}) deliberation, as विचर्, विचार; .³({%j%}) intensity; विध्वंस. .²2 As a prefix to nouns or adjectives not immediately connected with roots, वि expresses .³({%a%}) negation or privation, in which case it is used much in the same way as अ or निर्, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} it forms <ab>Bah. comp.</ab>; विधवा, व्यसुः <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) intensity, greatness; as विकराल; .³({%c%}) variety, as विचित्र; .³({%d%}) difference; as विलक्षण; .³({%e%}) manifoldness, as विविध; .³({%f%}) contrariety, opposition, as विलोम; .³({%g%}) change, as विकार; .³({%h%}) impropriety, as विजन्मन्.
